column1: # The services that must appear in a sealing measurement.
# "deployed" is yes for a service the fleet runs today. A service that is listed here
# and missing from a measurement is a FINDING, not a zero: it may be down, booting, or
# not advertising, and none of those is evidence that it seals.
# Filled from the fleet's release-targets on 2026-10-31 (19 mcl-* images on a track).
# Nine further mcl-* repos serve capabilities but are not deployed; they are deliberately
# absent here, so that a measurement cannot silently count a service nobody runs.
# mcl-fovea is the exception, and the first thing the measurement caught: the plan's
# inventory calls it "not deployed", but it advertises mcl-fovea/info and
# mcl-fovea/get_limits in the fleet's realm (measured 2026-10-31). It runs on a box
# outside this fleet repo and its reconciler (macula-fleet PORTS.md), which is why a
# survey of release targets could not see it. It is listed here because it SERVES,
# and a service that serves is a service whose absence must be a finding.
